name: smwmusic-castlevania-bloodlines-bane-of-tepes-theme-of-simon-remix
title: Castlevania: Bloodlines - Bane of Tepes ~ Theme of Simon (Remix)
description:
Been a while since I last did a Castlevania theme, so I decided to remix Theme of Simon from Castlevania: Bloodlines. Not a fan of Super Castlevania IV, but am a big fan of Bloodlines and its version of Simon Belmondo'st's theme. This ended up being one of my more fun remixes to work on, but it also took quite a while to do.

This baby can fit in castle / tower stages, industrial stages, final areas, intense cutscenes, and even second phase final boss fights.

Important:
- "Bonus End," Yoshi, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch)
